## Pipeline reporting digest
**Purpose:** a weekly summary a person can read in 30 seconds: candidates held in the database (kept separate), then the contacted > engaged > submitted > interview > offer > placed funnel, overall and by client and role.
**Honest by design:** records with an unrecognised stage are listed in a DATA CHECK line and are NOT counted, so the numbers are never quietly wrong.
**Use with real data:** replace "Pipeline data" with a CRM / Sheets read. Each record needs client, role and furthest_stage.
**Send it:** add a Slack or Email node after "Build digest" and send digest_text. Add a Schedule Trigger for weekly runs.
**Data:** all records are fictional.
